en.t: Pope Martin I is arrested and taken to Constantinople, due to his opposition to monothelitism
en.s: Pope Martin I (Latin: Martinus I, Greek: Πάπας Μαρτῖνος; between 590 and 600 – 16 September 655), also known as Martin the Confessor, was the bishop of Rome from 21 July 649 to 653 or 654. He had served as Pope Theodore I's ambassador to Constantinople, and was elected to succeed him as pope. He was the only pope when Constantinople controlled the papacy whose election had not awaited imperial mandate.

zh.s: 653年6月17日，因反对基督一志论而与拜占庭皇帝发生冲突的教宗玛尔定一世，在罗马拉特朗宫与认信者马克西穆斯一同被捕，随后被押往君士坦丁堡。

en.s: The Battle of Llandeilo Fawr took place during the conquest of Wales by Edward I, at Llandeilo between an English army led by Gilbert de Clare, 6th Earl of Hertford, and a South Welsh army led by Rhys ap Maredudd.

zh.s: 1282年6月17日，爱德华一世征服威尔士期间，吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔率领的英军与里斯·阿普·马雷迪兹率领的南威尔士军队在兰代洛交战。威尔士军获胜。

en.t: The kingdoms of Denmark, Sweden, and Norway formed the Kalmar Union, a personal union under Eric of Pomerania
en.s: The Kalmar Union was a personal union in Scandinavia, agreed at Kalmar in Sweden as designed by Queen Margaret of Denmark. From 1397 to 1523, it joined under a single monarch the three kingdoms of Denmark, Sweden (then including much of present-day Finland), and Norway, together with Norway's maritime colonies (then including Iceland, Greenland, the Faroe Islands, and the Northern Isles of Orkney and Shetland).

zh.s: 卡尔马联盟是斯堪的纳维亚的共主邦联，由丹麦女王玛格丽特提出并在瑞典卡尔马达成协议。1397年至1523年间，丹麦、瑞典（当时包括今芬兰的大部分地区）和挪威由同一君主统治；挪威当时还统治冰岛、格陵兰、法罗群岛以及奥克尼和设得兰群岛等海外领地。

en.s: The Battle of Beaugency took place on 16 and 17 June 1429. It was one of Joan of Arc's battles. Shortly after relieving the siege at Orléans, French forces recaptured the neighboring district along the Loire river.

zh.s: 博让西战役于1429年6月16日至17日发生，是圣女贞德参与的战役之一。奥尔良围城战解除后不久，法军重新夺回卢瓦尔河沿岸的邻近地区。

en.s: The night attack at Târgoviște (Romanian: Atacul de noapte de la Târgoviște) was a battle fought between forces of Prince Vlad III of Wallachia and Sultan Mehmed II of the Ottoman Empire on Thursday, 17 June 1462. The battle started after Mehmed II, who already had tense relations with Vlad, discovered his alliance with Hungary's king Matthias Corvinus and ordered his forces to ambush him.

zh.s: 特尔戈维什泰夜袭（罗马尼亚语：Atacul de noapte de la Târgoviște）是瓦拉几亚亲王弗拉德三世与奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆罕默德二世之间的一场战斗，发生于1462年6月17日星期四。穆罕默德二世与弗拉德关系紧张，发现弗拉德与匈牙利国王马蒂亚斯·科维努斯结盟后，下令伏击他，战斗由此爆发。

en.s: The Cornish rebellion of 1497 (Cornish: Rebellyans Kernow), also known as the First Cornish rebellion, was a popular uprising in the Kingdom of England, which began in Cornwall and culminated with the Battle of Deptford Bridge near London on 17 June 1497. The insurgent army mainly comprised Cornishmen, although it also gathered support from Devon, Somerset, and other English counties.

zh.s: 1497年康沃尔起义又称第一次康沃尔起义，是英格兰王国的一场民众起义。起义始于康沃尔，最终于1497年6月17日在伦敦附近的德普特福德桥战役中告终。起义军主要由康沃尔人组成，也得到德文郡、萨默塞特郡及英格兰其他郡的支持。

en.s: The Conquest of Stockholm (Swedish: Erövringen av Stockholm) was a battle in the Swedish War of Liberation that took place in Stockholm, Sweden on 17 June 1523. The Swedish forces had for a long time laid siege to Stockholm, which was the last Danish stronghold in Sweden. The city waited for reinforcement from Denmark, but none came.

zh.s: 攻占斯德哥尔摩（瑞典语：Erövringen av Stockholm）是瑞典解放战争期间的一场战斗，于1523年6月17日在瑞典斯德哥尔摩发生。瑞典军队已围困斯德哥尔摩很久，这座城市是丹麦在瑞典境内最后的据点。城中方面一直等待丹麦援军，但援军始终未到。

en.s: The Battle of Steenbergen, also known as the Capture of Steenbergen of 1583, took place on June 17, 1583, at Steenbergen, Duchy of Brabant, Spanish Netherlands (present-day North Brabant, the Netherlands), and was an important victory of the Spanish Army of Flanders led by Don Alexander Farnese, Prince of Parma (Spanish: Alejandro Farnesio), Governor-General of the Spanish Netherlands, over the French, English, and Dutch forces led by the French Marshal Armand de Gontaut, Baron de Biron, and the English commander Sir John Norreys, during the Eighty Years' War, the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604), and in the context of the French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 斯滕贝亨战役又称1583年斯滕贝亨陷落，发生于1583年6月17日，地点在西属尼德兰布拉班特公国的斯滕贝亨（今荷兰北布拉班特省）。这场战斗是帕尔马亲王亚历山大·法尔内塞（西班牙语名：亚历杭德罗·法尔内西奥）率领的西属尼德兰军队取得的一次重要胜利，对手是法国、英格兰和荷兰军队。后者由法国元帅阿尔芒·德·贡托、比龙男爵，以及英国指挥官约翰·诺里斯爵士率领。战斗发生在八十年战争、英西战争（1585—1604年）以及法国宗教战争期间。

en.s: The Action of 17 June 1595 was a naval battle between forces of Malta, then under the protection of the Order of Saint John, and Bizerte, then part of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1595年6月17日海战是马耳他军队与比塞大军队之间的一场海战。当时马耳他受圣约翰骑士团保护，比塞大则属于奥斯曼帝国。

en.t: The Dutch explorer Willem Barentsz discovers the Arctic archipelago of Spitsbergen
en.s: Willem Barentsz (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈʋɪləm ˈbaːrənts]; c. 1550 – 20 June 1597), anglicized as William Barents or Barentz, was a Dutch navigator, cartographer, and Arctic explorer. Barentsz went on three expeditions to the far north in search for a Northeast passage. He reached as far as Novaya Zemlya and the Kara Sea in his first two voyages, but was turned back on both occasions by ice.

zh.t: 巴伦支发现斯匹次卑尔根岛
zh.s: 1596年6月17日，荷兰航海家威廉·巴伦支在寻找东北航道的第三次北极航行中发现斯匹次卑尔根岛，首先看见了岛的西北海岸。

en.s: The Battle of Torzhok was a battle on June 17, 1609, between the advanced units of the Russian-Swedish army led by Prince Mikhail Skopin-Shuisky and Jacob De la Gardie and the army of Polish–Lithuanian invaders who fought for False Dmitry II, led by Alexander Zborovsky. It ended with the defeat of the interventionist troops and its retreat.

zh.s: 托尔若克战役于1609年6月17日爆发，交战双方为米哈伊尔·斯科平-舒伊斯基亲王和雅各布·德拉加迪率领的俄瑞联军先遣部队，以及为假德米特里二世作战、由亚历山大·兹博罗夫斯基率领的波兰—立陶宛入侵军。战斗以干涉军战败撤退告终。

en.t: Capture of the galleon Lion Couronné
en.s: The capture of the galleon Lion Couronné was a naval engagement that took place off Formentera on 17 June 1651, during the Franco-Spanish War (1635–1659). A squadron of eleven Spanish galleys under John Joseph of Austria captured the French galleon Lion Couronné after a fight.

zh.s: “加冕狮号”帆船被俘事件是法国—西班牙战争（1635—1659年）期间的一场海战，发生于1651年6月17日的福门特拉岛近海。约翰·约瑟夫·奥地利亲王率领11艘西班牙桨帆船组成的舰队与法军交战，最终俘获法国帆船“加冕狮号”。

en.s: The Battle of Montes Claros was fought on 17 June 1665, near Borba, between Spanish and a combined Anglo-Portuguese force as the last major battle in the Portuguese Restoration War. The battle resulted in a decisive Portuguese victory and is considered one of the most important battles in the country's history.

zh.s: 蒙特斯克拉鲁斯战役于1665年6月17日在博尔巴附近爆发，交战双方是西班牙军队与英葡联军。这是葡萄牙复国战争的最后一场主要战役。葡萄牙一方取得决定性胜利，这场战役被认为是葡萄牙历史上最重要的战役之一。

en.s: The Skirmish at Nauen (German: Gefecht bei Nauen or Duell vor Nauen), took place on 17 June [O.S. 27 June] 1675 near the town of Nauen between the vanguard of the Brandenburg-Prussian army and Swedish rearguard units during the Swedish-Brandenburg War. The engagement ended with the capture of the town of Nauen by Brandenburg-Prussia. The decisive military victory in favour of Brandenburg, however, took place at the Battle of Fehrbellin on the following day.

zh.s: 瑙恩小规模交战（德语：Gefecht bei Nauen或Duell vor Nauen）发生于1675年6月17日（儒略历6月27日），地点在瑙恩镇附近，交战双方为勃兰登堡—普鲁士军队前锋和瑞典后卫部队，是瑞典—勃兰登堡战争的一部分。战斗结束后，勃兰登堡—普鲁士军队攻占瑙恩镇。不过，次日在费尔贝林战役中，勃兰登堡一方才取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Dogger Bank was a naval battle fought on 17 June 1696 as part of the War of the Grand Alliance. It was a victory for a French force of seven ships over a Dutch force of five ships and the convoy it was escorting.

en.s: The Battle of Velletri were two battles between Austria and the Kingdom of Naples in 1744 during the War of the Austrian Succession around the city of Velletri, then part of the Papal States. The first battle took place in the night of 16–17 June 1744, when the Spanish-Neapolitan army launched a surprise attack and conquered 3 important hills.

en.s: The Siege of Cuddalore was a battle during the War of the Austrian Succession on 17 June 1748. After a British raiding squadron left for Madras, Joseph François Dupleix decided to make another attack on Cuddalore, where the British had taken refuge after the fall of Madras. He was assisted by Bertrand-François Mahé de La Bourdonnais. Commanding a force of 800 Europeans and 1,000 Indian sepoys, Dupleix marched from Pondicherry and arrived on the hills at Bandapolam, three miles from Cuddalore, on the morning of 17th June. Planning to take the town by surprise, Dupleix stopped until night.

zh.s: 库达洛尔围城战是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场战斗，发生于1748年6月17日。英国袭击舰队离开前往马德拉斯后，约瑟夫·弗朗索瓦·迪普莱决定再次进攻库达洛尔。英军在马德拉斯陷落后曾退到库达洛尔避难。迪普莱得到贝特朗-弗朗索瓦·马埃·德·拉布尔多内协助，率领800名欧洲士兵和1,000名印度土兵从本地治里出发，于6月17日早晨抵达班达波拉姆山，距库达洛尔约3英里。迪普莱计划趁夜突袭该城，因此暂时停下行军。

en.s: The Battle of Bunker Hill was fought on June 17, 1775, during the Siege of Boston in the early stages of the American Revolutionary War. The battle is named after Bunker Hill in Charlestown, Massachusetts, which was peripherally involved in the battle. It was the original objective of both the colonial and British troops, though the majority of combat took place on the adjacent Breed's Hill. On June 13, 1775, the leaders of the colonial forces besieging Boston learned that the British were planning to send troops out from the city to fortify the unoccupied hills surrounding the city, giving them control of Boston Harbor.

zh.s: 邦克山战役于1775年6月17日爆发。当时波士顿遭到围困，这场战役发生在美国独立战争初期。战役以马萨诸塞州查尔斯镇的邦克山命名，但邦克山只在战斗中起到边缘作用；大部分战斗发生在旁边的布里德山。1775年6月13日，围困波士顿的殖民地军队领导人得知，英军准备派兵出城，占领周边尚未设防的山丘，以控制波士顿港。

en.s: The action of 17 June 1778 (also known as the fight of Belle Poule and Arethusa) was a single-ship action that took place off the coast of France between British and French frigates. It was widely celebrated in both France and Great Britain and was the first engagement fought between the two nations during the American Revolutionary War before a formal declaration of war was even announced.

zh.s: 1778年6月17日海战又称“贝尔·普尔号与阿瑞图莎号之战”，是英法护卫舰在法国海岸附近进行的一场单舰交战。这场战斗在法国和英国都受到广泛关注，也是美国独立战争期间两国正式宣战前发生的第一次交战。

en.s: During the French Revolution, the National Assembly (French: Assemblée nationale, [asɑ̃ble nɑsjɔnal] ), which existed from 17 June 1789 to 9 July 1789, was a revolutionary assembly of the Kingdom of France formed by the representatives of the Third Estate (commoners) of the Estates-General and eventually joined by some members of the First and Second Estates.

zh.s: 法国大革命期间，国民议会（法语：Assemblée nationale）于1789年6月17日至7月9日存在，是法兰西王国的一个革命议会。议会最初由三级会议中的第三等级（平民）代表组成，后来第一和第二等级的一些成员也加入其中。

en.s: The Battle of Mykonos was a minor naval engagement fought in the main harbour of the Cycladic island of Mykonos on 17 June 1794 during the War of the First Coalition. A Royal Navy squadron led by fourth rate ship HMS Romney was escorting a convoy of eight merchant ships westwards through the Aegean Sea to Smyrna when the French frigate Sibylle was sighted at anchor in the harbour of Mykonos town with three French merchant ships.

zh.s: 米科诺斯战役是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一场小规模海战，于1794年6月17日在基克拉泽斯群岛米科诺斯岛的主港口发生。英国皇家海军英国皇家海军四级舰“罗姆尼”号率领分舰队，护送8艘商船向西穿越爱琴海、驶往士麦那；途中发现法国护卫舰“西比尔”号和3艘法国商船停泊在米科诺斯镇港内。

en.s: Cornwallis's Retreat was a naval engagement during the French Revolutionary Wars in which a British Royal Navy squadron of five ships of the line and two frigates was attacked by a much larger French Navy fleet of 12 ships of the line and 11 frigates. The action took place in the waters off the west coast of Brittany on 16–17 June 1795 (28–29 Prairial an III of the French Republican Calendar).

zh.s: 康沃利斯撤退战是法国大革命战争期间的一场海战。英国皇家海军一支由5艘战列舰和2艘护卫舰组成的舰队，遭到法国海军一支规模大得多的舰队攻击，后者有12艘战列舰和11艘护卫舰。战斗于1795年6月16日至17日在布列塔尼西岸海域发生（法国共和历三年牧月二十八日至二十九日）。

en.s: The Battle off Cape Gata, which took place June 17, 1815, off the south-east coast of Spain, was the first battle of the Second Barbary War. A squadron of U.S. vessels, under the command of Stephen Decatur Jr., met and engaged the flagship of the Algerine Navy, the frigate Meshuda under Admiral Hamidou. After a sharp action, Decatur's squadron captured the Algerine frigate and won a decisive victory over the Algerines.

zh.s: 加塔角海战于1815年6月17日在西班牙东南海岸附近发生，是第二次巴巴里战争的第一场战斗。斯蒂芬·迪凯特率领一支美国舰队，与阿尔及尔海军旗舰“梅舒达”号护卫舰交战；该舰由哈米杜海军上将指挥。激战后，迪凯特的舰队俘获这艘阿尔及尔护卫舰，决定性地击败阿尔及尔一方。

en.t: Best Friend of Charleston locomotive boiler explodes
en.s: On June 17, 1831, the boiler of the Best Friend of Charleston exploded while the locomotive was in service in South Carolina. The blast killed its fireman. The locomotive is widely described as the first in the United States to suffer a boiler explosion.

zh.t: “查尔斯顿挚友”号蒸汽机车锅炉爆炸
zh.s: 1831年6月17日，美国南卡罗来纳州的“查尔斯顿挚友”号蒸汽机车在运行时锅炉爆炸，司炉工身亡。它被广泛认为是美国第一台发生锅炉爆炸的机车。

en.s: The St. Joseph Mutiny was a mutiny which occurred in June 1837 among the 1st West India Regiment of the British Army. It began at the unit's barracks in St. Joseph, Trinidad, then part of the British West Indies. It was led by recently arrived Africans who had been liberated from illegal slave ships by the Royal Navy and subsequently conscripted into the West India Regiments.

en.s: The Battle of Vienna, Virginia was a minor engagement between Union and Confederate forces on June 17, 1861, during the early days of the American Civil War. The Union was trying to protect the areas of Virginia opposite Washington, D.C., and established a camp at Vienna, at the end of a 15-mile railroad to Alexandria. As Union Brig. Gen. Robert C. Schenck was transporting the 1st Ohio Infantry to Vienna by train, they were overheard by Confederate scouts led by Colonel Maxcy Gregg, who set up an ambush.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州维也纳战役是美国内战初期的一场小规模交战，发生于1861年6月17日，交战双方为联邦军和邦联军。联邦军试图保护华盛顿特区对岸的弗吉尼亚地区，并在维也纳设营；维也纳位于一条通往亚历山德里亚、全长15英里的铁路终点。联邦准将罗伯特·C·申克乘火车运送俄亥俄州第一步兵团前往维也纳时，麦克西·格雷格上校率领的邦联侦察兵听到了他们的动静，随后设下埋伏。

en.s: The First Battle of Boonville was a minor skirmish of the American Civil War, occurring on June 17, 1861, near Boonville in Cooper County, Missouri. Although casualties were extremely light, the battle's strategic impact was far greater than one might assume from its limited nature. The Union victory established what would become an unbroken Federal control of the Missouri River, and helped to thwart efforts to bring Missouri into the Confederacy. Four battles were fought at Boonville during the Civil War: the first battle forms the main subject of this article, while the others are described below under .

zh.s: 布恩维尔第一次战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，发生于1861年6月17日，地点在密苏里州库珀县布恩维尔附近。虽然伤亡极少，这场战斗的战略影响却远超其规模。联邦军获胜后，联邦一方得以持续控制密苏里河，并挫败了将密苏里州拉入邦联的努力。内战期间布恩维尔共发生四场战斗；本文主要讲述第一次战役，其余几场在下文另述。

en.s: The Battle of St. Charles was fought on June 17, 1862, at St. Charles, Arkansas, during the American Civil War. Earlier in 1862, a Union Army force commanded by Major General Samuel R. Curtis moved against Little Rock, Arkansas, but became bogged down in the Batesville area due to lack of supplies. The Union leadership decided to send a naval force from Memphis, Tennessee, up the White River to resupply Curtis's men.

zh.s: 圣查尔斯战役于1862年6月17日在阿肯色州圣查尔斯爆发，是美国内战的一部分。1862年早些时候，塞缪尔·R·柯蒂斯少将率领联邦军向阿肯色州小石城推进，但因补给不足，在贝茨维尔一带受阻。联邦军领导层决定从田纳西州孟菲斯派出海军舰队，沿怀特河上行，为柯蒂斯部队补给。

en.s: The Battle of Wassaw Sound (or the Capture of the CSS Atlanta) was an American Civil War naval battle between the Confederate ram CSS Atlanta and the Passaic-class ironclad monitors USS Weehawken and USS Nahant and the gunboat USS Cimmerone (later named Cimmaron), which took place on 17 June 1863 in Wassaw Sound, a bay in the present day state of Georgia. Atlanta ran aground while attempting to break the Union blockade, and after a short battle surrendered to the Union forces. Captain Rodgers became a national hero, and he was promoted to Commodore and received the Thanks of Congress as a result of his decisive victory.

zh.s: 沃索湾海战又称“俘获亚特兰大号”，是美国内战期间的一场海战，发生于1863年6月17日。邦联装甲舰“亚特兰大”号与联邦军的帕赛克级铁甲舰“威霍肯”号、“纳汉特”号及炮艇“西默罗恩”号（后更名为“西马伦”号）交战。战斗地点沃索湾是今佐治亚州境内的一个海湾。“亚特兰大”号试图突破联邦封锁时搁浅，短暂交战后向联邦军投降。罗杰斯舰长因此成为全国英雄，晋升准将，并获国会致谢，以表彰他取得的决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Aldie took place on June 17, 1863, in Loudoun County, Virginia, as part of the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Maj. Gen. J.E.B. Stuart's cavalry screened Gen. Robert E. Lee's Confederate infantry as it marched north in the Shenandoah Valley behind the sheltering Blue Ridge Mountains. The pursuing Union cavalry of Brig. Gen. Judson Kilpatrick's brigade, in the advance of Brig. Gen. David McM. Gregg's division, encountered Col. Thomas T. Munford's troopers near the village of Aldie, resulting in four hours of stubborn fighting. Both sides made mounted assaults by regiments and squadrons.

zh.s: 奥尔迪战役于1863年6月17日在弗吉尼亚州劳登县爆发，是美国内战葛底斯堡战役的一部分。J·E·B·斯图尔特少将率领骑兵，为罗伯特·E·李将军的邦联步兵在蓝岭山脉掩护下北上提供屏护。联邦军准将朱德森·基尔帕特里克的骑兵旅追击而来；该旅位于准将戴维·麦克默特里·格雷格师的前锋，在奥尔迪村附近遇上托马斯·T·芒福德上校的骑兵。双方激战四小时，骑兵按团和中队发起多次冲锋。

en.s: The "Battle of Fort Fizzle" (also called the Holmes County Draft Riots and the Holmes County Rebellion) was a skirmish fought on June 17, 1863, which took place during the American Civil War in the village of Glenmont (then known as Napoleon) in Holmes County, Ohio, between Union troops and local draft resisters opposed to the Conscription Act of 1863. Adopted by Congress on March 13, 1863, the Conscription Act authorized President Abraham Lincoln to draft men into military service in states that did not meet their volunteer quotas.

zh.s: “菲兹尔堡战役”又称霍姆斯县征兵骚乱或霍姆斯县叛乱，是美国内战期间的一场小规模冲突，发生于1863年6月17日。地点在俄亥俄州霍姆斯县格伦蒙特村（当时名为拿破仑），交战双方为联邦军和当地反征兵者；后者反对1863年《征兵法》。国会于1863年3月13日通过该法，授权亚伯拉罕·林肯总统在志愿兵人数未达到配额的州征召男子入伍。

en.s: The Battle of Lynchburg was fought on June 17–18, 1864, as part of the American Civil War. Over 30,000 soldiers were at the battle, and fighting took place outside of Lynchburg, Virginia. The Union Army of West Virginia, commanded by Major General David Hunter, attempted to capture the city. Hunter took too much time moving his force to Lynchburg; allowing Confederate reinforcements time to arrive to defend the city.

zh.s: 林奇堡战役于1864年6月17日至18日发生，是美国内战的一部分。共有3万多名士兵参战，战斗发生在弗吉尼亚州林奇堡城外。戴维·亨特少将指挥的西弗吉尼亚联邦军试图攻占该城。亨特调动部队前往林奇堡时耗时过久，使邦联援军得以赶到并守卫该城。

en.s: The siege of Tashkent (9 May – 17 June 1865) was the last major battle between the Khanate of Kokand and the Russian Empire during the Russo-Kokand War. During the battle, Alimqul, the de-facto leader of Kokand was killed. In the aftermath of the battle, the khanate was greatly weakened. The Russian Empire would annex the city, strengthening its position in Central Asia and facilitating its later conquest of Bukhara.

zh.s: 塔什干围城战于1865年5月9日至6月17日进行，是浩罕汗国与俄罗斯帝国在俄浩战争期间最后一场主要战役。战斗中，浩罕实际领导人阿里木库尔阵亡。此后，汗国实力大为削弱。俄罗斯帝国随后吞并塔什干，加强了其在中亚的地位，也为日后征服布哈拉提供了条件。

en.s: The Battle of the Rosebud (also known as the Battle of Rosebud Creek) occurred June 17, 1876, in the Montana Territory between the United States Army and its Crow and Shoshoni allies against a force consisting mostly of Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne Indians during the Great Sioux War of 1876. The Cheyenne called it the Battle Where the Girl Saved Her Brother, because of an incident during the fight involving Buffalo Calf Road Woman. General George Crook's offensive was stymied by the Indians, led by Crazy Horse, and he awaited reinforcements before resuming the campaign in August.

zh.s: 罗斯巴德战役又称罗斯巴德溪战役，于1876年6月17日在蒙大拿领地爆发。交战双方是美国陆军及其克罗人、肖肖尼人盟友，以及主要由拉科塔苏族和北夏延人组成的部队。这场战役是1876年大苏族战争的一部分。夏延人称之为“女孩救了她的兄弟之战”，源于战斗中布法罗小道女人的一段经历。乔治·克鲁克将军的进攻被疯马率领的原住民部队阻止；克鲁克等到8月获得增援后才恢复行动。

en.s: The Battle of White Bird Canyon was fought on June 17, 1877 in Idaho Territory. White Bird Canyon was the opening battle of the Nez Perce War between the Nez Perce Indians and the United States. The battle was a significant defeat of the U.S. Army. It took place in the western part of present-day Idaho County, southwest of the city of Grangeville.

zh.s: 白鸟峡谷战役于1877年6月17日在爱达荷领地爆发，是内兹珀斯战争的第一场战役，交战双方为内兹珀斯人和美国军队。美军在战斗中遭到重大失败。战场位于今爱达荷州爱达荷县西部，格兰奇维尔市西南方。

en.s: The 1890 Quebec general election was held on June 17, 1890, to elect members of the 7th Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party Parti national coalition led by Honoré Mercier, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Louis-Olivier Taillon. A scandal and charges of corruption cut short Mercier's term of office.

en.s: General elections were held in South Africa on 17 June 1924, electing 135 members of the House of Assembly. Considered a realigning election, rising discontent with the government of Jan Smuts led to the defeat of his government by a coalition of the pro-Afrikaner National Party and the South African Labour Party, a socialist party representing the interests of the white proletariat.

zh.s: 南非于1924年6月17日举行大选，选出众议院135名议员。这次选举改变了政治格局：扬·史末资政府日益失去支持，最终败给由亲阿非利卡人的国民党和南非工党组成的联合政府。南非工党是一个代表白人工人阶层利益的社会主义政党。

en.t: U.S. president Herbert Hoover signs the Smoot–Hawley Tariff Act into law
en.s: The Tariff Act of 1930, also known as the Smoot–Hawley Tariff Act, was a protectionist trade measure signed into law in the United States by President Herbert Hoover on June 17, 1930. Named after its chief congressional sponsors, Senator Reed Smoot and Representative Willis C. Hawley, the act raised tariffs on over 20,000 imported goods in an effort to shield American industries from foreign competition during the onset of the Great Depression, which had started in October 1929.

zh.t: 美国总统赫伯特·胡佛签署《斯穆特—霍利关税法》
zh.s: 《1930年关税法》又称《斯穆特—霍利关税法》，是一项保护主义贸易措施，由美国总统赫伯特·胡佛于1930年6月17日签署生效。该法以主要国会提案人、参议员里德·斯穆特和众议员威利斯·C·霍利命名。为在1929年10月开始的大萧条初期保护美国工业免受外国竞争，该法提高了两万多种进口商品的关税。

en.t: Third encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet
en.s: The third encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet was an encirclement campaign launched by the Chinese Nationalist Government against the Communist base in the Hubei–Henan–Anhui border region, the Eyuwan Soviet. The Fourth Red Army responded with its third counter-encirclement campaign, which successfully defended the soviet. The Nationalist attacks lasted from November 1931 to 17 June 1932.

zh.s: 第三次围剿鄂豫皖苏区是中国国民政府针对鄂豫皖边区共产党根据地发动的一次围剿。红四方面军随后发起第三次反围剿并成功守住苏区。国民党军的进攻从1931年11月持续到1932年6月17日。

en.s: The Kansas City massacre was the shootout and murder of four law enforcement officers and a criminal fugitive at the Union Station railroad depot in Kansas City, Missouri, on the morning of June 17, 1933. It occurred as part of the attempt by a gang led by Vernon Miller to free Frank "Jelly" Nash, a federal prisoner. At the time, Nash was in the custody of several law enforcement officers who were returning him to the U.S. Penitentiary at Leavenworth, Kansas, from which he had escaped three years earlier. Charles "Pretty Boy" Floyd was identified by the FBI as one of the gunmen.

zh.s: 堪萨斯城大屠杀发生于1933年6月17日上午，地点在密苏里州堪萨斯城的联合车站铁路站点。当时发生枪战，四名执法人员和一名逃犯被杀。这是弗农·米勒帮派营救囚犯弗兰克·“果冻”·纳什的行动之一。当时纳什由数名执法人员押送，正要从堪萨斯州利文沃思联邦监狱返回美国监狱；三年前他曾从那里越狱。联邦调查局认定查尔斯·“漂亮男孩”·弗洛伊德是枪手之一。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1938 was held on 17 June 1938. The 138 newly elected members of the 10th Dáil assembled on 30 June when the new Taoiseach and government were appointed. Fianna Fáil retained power, and won the first overall majority in the history of the State. The general election took place in 34 parliamentary constituencies throughout Ireland for 138 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1938年6月17日举行大选。新当选的第十届众议院有138名议员，于6月30日召开会议，任命新任总理和政府。共和党（Fianna Fáil）继续执政，并首次在爱尔兰自由邦历史上赢得绝对多数。选举在爱尔兰全国34个选区举行，改选众议院138个席位。

en.t: Last public guillotining in France: Eugen Weidmann, a convicted murderer, is executed in Versailles outside the Saint-Pierre prison
en.s: Eugen Weidmann (5 February 1908 – 17 June 1939) was a German-born criminal and serial killer who was executed by guillotine in France in June 1939, the last public execution in France, an execution witnessed by the 17-year-old Christopher Lee who was visiting Paris at the time.

zh.t: 法国最后一次公开断头台行刑：欧根·魏德曼在凡尔赛被处决
zh.s: 欧根·魏德曼（1908年2月5日—1939年6月17日）是出生于德国的罪犯和连环杀手，1939年6月在法国被断头台处决。这是法国最后一次公开行刑。17岁的克里斯托弗·李当时正在巴黎探访，目睹了这次行刑。

en.s: On 17 June 1940, during the later stages of the Battle of France, the Luftwaffe launched an air raid on Rennes. The attack was against the Rennes marshalling yards, congested at the time by troop-trains and others carrying refugees from northern France. The explosion of two trains loaded with ammunition and high explosives unleashed havoc throughout the railway station and the city, killing between 800 and 2,000 people among civilians and Allied military personnel.

zh.s: 1940年6月17日，法国战役后期，德国空军空袭雷恩，目标是雷恩编组站。当时车站挤满运送部队和从法国北部撤离难民的列车。两列装载弹药和烈性炸药的火车爆炸，车站和城市遭到严重破坏，平民和盟军军人死亡人数估计在800至2,000人之间。

en.s: The Battle of Kissoué (17 June 1941) was part of the Allied advance on Damascus in Syria during the Syria-Lebanon campaign in World War II. The battle is noted for the confrontation between Vichy French and the Free French Forces. The Free French met with stiff resistance from the Vichy French.

zh.s: 基苏埃战役发生于1941年6月17日，是第二次世界大战期间盟军在叙利亚—黎巴嫩战役中向大马士革推进的一部分。战斗中，维希法国军队与自由法国军队交锋。自由法国军队遭到维希法国军队的顽强抵抗。

en.s: Operation Battleaxe (15–17 June 1941) was a British Army offensive during the Second World War to raise the Siege of Tobruk and re-capture eastern Cyrenaica from German and Italian forces. It was the first time during the war that a significant German force fought on the defensive. The British lost over half of their tanks on the first day and only one of three attacks succeeded.

zh.s: 战斧行动于1941年6月15日至17日进行，是第二次世界大战期间英国陆军发起的一次攻势，旨在解除托布鲁克围城，并从德意军手中夺回昔兰尼加东部。这是战争期间德军首次以大规模部队转入防御。英军在第一天就损失了一半以上的坦克，三次进攻中只有一次成功。

en.s: The Battle of Douvres Radar Station was military engagement of World war II as part of the Invasion of Normandy, that took place the on 17 June 1944. The attack was by British 41 Commando, Royal Marines, the station and area were defended mainly by Luftwaffe ground forces. Preceded by an artillery bombardment and supported by mine-clearing and anti-bunker tanks of 79th Armoured Division, the Marines were able to secure the surrender of the garrison.

zh.s: 多夫尔雷达站战役是第二次世界大战期间的一场军事交战，属于诺曼底登陆行动的一部分，发生于1944年6月17日。英国皇家海军陆战队第41突击队发起攻击；雷达站及周边地区主要由德国空军地面部队防守。海军陆战队先进行炮击，并得到第79装甲师排雷及反碉堡坦克的支援，最终促使守军投降。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Iceland on 17 June 1944 following the approval of a new constitution and the transition of the country to a republic the previous month. Sveinn Björnsson was elected and appointed by the Parliament for a one-year term.

en.t: Iceland declares independence from Denmark and becomes a republic
en.s: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America. It is Europe's westernmost and most sparsely populated country. Its capital and largest city is Reykjavík, which is home to about 35% of the country's roughly 395,000 residents (excluding nearby towns/suburbs, which are separate municipalities and contribute a further substantial percentage).

zh.s: 冰岛是位于北冰洋与北大西洋之间的北欧岛国，地处连接欧洲和北美的中大西洋海岭，是欧洲最西端、人口最稀少的国家。首都兼最大城市雷克雅未克居住着全国约35%的人口；全国人口约39.5万（邻近的独立市镇和郊区另计，人口占比也相当可观）。冰岛的官方语言为冰岛语；该国位于板块裂谷带，地质活动包括间歇泉和频繁的火山喷发。

en.s: United Air Lines Flight 624 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from San Diego, California, to New York City, with stopovers in Los Angeles and Chicago. The four-engined, propeller-driven Douglas DC-6 crashed at 1:41 pm Eastern Daylight Time on June 17, 1948, outside Aristes, Pennsylvania, resulting in the deaths of all 4 crew members and 39 passengers on board.

zh.s: 联合航空624号班机是一趟美国国内定期客运航班，从圣迭戈飞往纽约，中途经停洛杉矶和芝加哥。1948年6月17日美国东部夏令时间下午1时41分，这架四引擎螺旋桨道格拉斯DC-6客机在宾夕法尼亚州阿里斯特斯附近坠毁，机上4名机组人员和39名乘客全部遇难。

en.s: Battle of Shangcai was a series of clashes fought between the nationalists and the communists during Chinese Civil War in the post World War II era, and resulted in the communist victory. The battle is also called the Blockade at Shangcai (Chinese: 上蔡阻击战) by the communists, who launched the battle to support their Eastern Hennan Campaign, with intention to prevent the nationalist force from reinforcing their comrades fighting the Eastern Hennan Campaign.

en.s: The 1950 New South Wales state election was held on 17 June 1950. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1949 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly, which was an increase of 4 seats since the previous election.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州于1950年6月17日举行州选举。选举采用单一议席选区和强制优先选择投票制，选区边界依据1949年重新划界结果。立法议会全部94个席位均参与改选，比上届增加4席。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 17 June 1951 to elect the second National Assembly of the Fourth Republic. After the Second World War, the three parties which took a major part in the French Resistance to the German occupation dominated the political scene and government: the French Communist Party (PCF), the French Section of the Workers' International (SFIO, socialist party) and the Christian democratic Popular Republican Movement (MRP). The forces associated with the Third Republic and the 1940 disaster (the Radical Party and the classical Right) were considered as archaic and were the losers of the post-war elections.

zh.s: 法国于1951年6月17日举行立法选举，选出法兰西第四共和国第二届国民议会。第二次世界大战后，曾积极抵抗德国占领的三大政党主导了法国政坛和政府：法国共产党、工人国际法国支部（社会主义政党）和基督教民主主义的人民共和运动。与第三共和国及1940年法国战败相关的政治力量——激进党和传统右翼——被视为过时势力，在战后选举中失利。

en.s: The East German uprising of 1953 (German: Volksaufstand vom 17. Juni 1953) was an uprising that occurred over the course of two days in German Democratic Republic (GDR) from 16 to 17 June 1953. It began with strike action by construction workers in East Berlin on 16 June against work quotas during the Sovietization process in East Germany.

zh.s: 1953年东德起义（德语：Volksaufstand vom 17. Juni 1953）是德意志民主共和国境内持续两天的起义，于1953年6月16日至17日发生。6月16日，东柏林建筑工人因反对东德苏维埃化进程中的劳动定额而罢工，起义由此开始。
zh.n: 1953年东德起义持续两天，发生于1953年6月16日至17日。

en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1959 was held on 17 June 1959. Fianna Fáil's founder and longtime leader, Taoiseach Éamon de Valera (under pressure from members of his party) decided to leave active party politics and seek the presidency. The main opposition party, Fine Gael, decided to run its defeated candidate in 1945, Seán Mac Eoin, against him. As expected, Éamon de Valera won the presidency.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1959年6月17日举行总统选举。共和党（Fianna Fáil）创始人、长期担任党魁的总理埃蒙·德·瓦莱拉在党内人士施压下，决定退出活跃的党务工作，竞选总统。主要反对党统一党决定派出曾在1945年败选的肖恩·麦克埃因与他竞争。结果不出所料，德·瓦莱拉当选总统。

en.s: The 1962 FIFA World Cup final was the deciding match of the 1962 FIFA World Cup. The match was held at the Estadio Nacional in Santiago, and was contested by Czechoslovakia and Brazil. Brazil won the game 3–1 to record their second consecutive World Cup victory. Both teams had played each other during the group stage which ended in a goalless draw. This was the second World Cup final match featuring teams who had already competed against each other during the group stage (the first was the 1954 final between Hungary and West Germany). This event was on Sunday, 17 June 1962.

zh.s: 1962年国际足联世界杯决赛决定了该届世界杯冠军。比赛于1962年6月17日星期日在圣地亚哥国家体育场举行，由捷克斯洛伐克对阵巴西。巴西以3比1获胜，连续第二次夺得世界杯冠军。两队在小组赛阶段曾交手，当时以0比0战平。这是世界杯决赛第二次由小组赛中已经交过手的球队对阵；第一次是1954年匈牙利对西德的决赛。

en.s: The Communist insurgency in Malaysia, also known as the Second Malayan Emergency (Malay: Perang insurgensi melawan pengganas komunis or Darurat Kedua), was an armed conflict which occurred in Malaysia from 1968 to 1989, between the Malayan Communist Party (MCP) and Malaysian federal security forces. zh.s: 马来西亚共产党武装叛乱又称第二次马来亚紧急状态（马来语：Perang insurgensi melawan pengganas komunis或Darurat Kedua），是1968年至1989年马来亚共产党与马来西亚联邦安全部队之间的武装冲突。1960年马来亚紧急状态结束后，马来亚民族解放军（该党以华人为主的武装组织）撤至马来西亚与泰国边境，重新集结和训练，为今后对马来西亚政府发动攻势作准备。

en.t: Italy v West Germany (1970 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The semi-final of the 1970 FIFA World Cup between Italy and West Germany has been called the "Game of the Century" (Spanish: Partido del Siglo; Italian: Partita del secolo; German: Jahrhundertspiel). It was played on 17 June 1970 at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City. Italy won 4–3 after five of the seven goals were scored in extra time, the record for most goals scored during extra time in a FIFA World Cup game.

zh.t: 1970年世界杯意大利对西德半决赛
zh.s: 1970年世界杯意大利对阵西德的半决赛被称为“世纪之战”（西班牙语：Partido del Siglo；意大利语：Partita del secolo；德语：Jahrhundertspiel）。比赛于1970年6月17日在墨西哥城阿兹特克体育场举行。意大利以4比3获胜，七个进球中有五个出现在加时赛，这仍是世界杯单场比赛加时赛进球数的纪录。

en.s: The Western Sahara conflict is an ongoing conflict between the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) and the Kingdom of Morocco. The conflict originated from an insurgency by the Polisario Front against Spanish colonial forces from 1973 to 1975 and the subsequent Western Sahara War against Morocco between 1975 and 1991. en.s: The war on drugs, sometimes referred to in the 21st century as the war on cartels in contexts of military intervention and counterterrorism, is a global anti-narcotics campaign led by the United States federal government, ramped up after 9/11, including drug prohibition and foreign assistance, with the aim of reducing the illegal drug trade in the US. The initiative's efforts includes policies intended to discourage the production, distribution, and consumption of psychoactive drugs that the participating governments, through United Nations treaties, have made illegal. The term "war on drugs" was popularized by the media after a press conference, given on June 17, 1971, during which President Richard Nixon declared drug abuse "public enemy number one".

zh.s: 禁毒战争有时也被称为“打击毒品集团战争”，尤其是在21世纪有关军事干预和反恐的讨论中。美国联邦政府领导这场全球禁毒行动，9·11事件后力度加大，包括禁止毒品和向海外提供援助，目标是减少美国的非法毒品交易。参与国通过联合国条约将某些精神活性药物定为非法，相关政策旨在阻止这些药物的生产、分销和使用。“禁毒战争”一词在媒体中广为流传，源自1971年6月17日的一场记者会；理查德·尼克松总统在会上称药物滥用是“头号公敌”。

en.s: El Juicio Final (2011) (Spanish for "The Final Justice") was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on June 17, 2011 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico. The main event of the show was a Lucha de Apuestas, Mask vs. Mask match between Averno and La Máscara. After losing the match, Averno removed his mask and revealed that he was Renato Ruíz Cortes, 34-year-old 16-year veteran from Mexico City. en.t: Syrian civil war spillover in Lebanon
en.s: Between 2011 and 2017, fighting from the Syrian civil war spilled over into Lebanon as opponents and supporters of the Ba'athist Syrian regime traveled to Lebanon to fight and attack each other on Lebanese soil. en.t: Juneteenth National Independence Day is signed into law by President Joe Biden, to become the first federal holiday established since Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 1983
en.s: Juneteenth, officially Juneteenth National Independence Day, is a federal holiday in the United States. It is celebrated annually on June 19 to commemorate the end of slavery in the United States. The holiday's name, first used in the 1890s, is a portmanteau of June and nineteenth, referring to June 19, 1865, the day when Major General Gordon Granger ordered the final enforcement of the Emancipation Proclamation in Texas at the end of the American Civil War.
